mainEntity.name: Are your heavy bridal jhumkas comfortable to wear for full-day wedding rituals?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! We utilize lightweight hollow-core crafting and wide-disc support backings that distribute weight evenly. For very large statement jhumkas, we also provide matching ear-chains (Mattal) that hook securely into your hair to carry 70% of the earring weight.

mainEntity.name: Can I purchase matching ear-chains (Mattals) for these earrings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! We offer matching kemp, pearl-strand, and gold-plated Mattals (hair extension chains) that attach seamlessly to our jhumkas and chandbalis for a complete traditional bridal look.

mainEntity.name: What type of back closures do your earrings have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our collection features either traditional screw-back posts (Bombay screws) or premium push-backs with wide comfort silicone stabilizers that keep the earrings standing upright without drooping forward.

mainEntity.name: Can I match earrings to a necklace I already own?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Simply send a photo of your existing necklace or saree to our WhatsApp styling team (+91 98447 58450). We will recommend earrings with matching stone settings, gold finish tones, and drop proportions.

mainEntity.name: What is the delivery timeline for earrings ordered in Bangalore and across India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bangalore city deliveries arrive in 24 to 48 hours via express courier. Pan-India orders are dispatched in padded, damage-proof hard jewelry boxes and delivered within 10 days with complete tracking.

mainEntity.name: Are your ear studs suitable for newly pierced or sensitive ears?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! All our earring posts are 100% nickel-free and electroplated in pure 24k hypoallergenic micro gold, making them gentle and safe even for sensitive ear lobes prone to redness or irritation.
